title: [Chapitre] IX et IX bis. [Ateliers] : notes manuscrites (05-15/07/1986).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: in July 1986 Grothendieck is axiomatizing 'ateliers spatiaux'. As the page suggests, these are sets 𝒜 of 'figures' carrying a sub-figure order ⊴, a relation ≪̊ (roughly 'interior/strict containment') and a symmetric relation |∘|. He then tries to realize such a structure inside an ambient 'spatial' set Σ, which has an order ≤ and a complement ∁. Each figure X is sent to Dép(X) ⊂ Σ, a family of elements of Σ that are nonempty and pairwise separated (S ≤ ∁T or T ≤ ∁S). The relation 'Dép X ≪̊ Dép Y' is pulled back to a preorder on 𝒜. Condition (ii), injectivity of Dép, makes it an order. He wants the induced ≪ to agree with the one coming from Fils(Σ).

This page checks the axioms of the transported structure one by one.

(Ax 1, end of the argument started on p.44.) Suppose Dép X ≪̊ 𝔏 ≤ Dép(Y), where 𝔏 is the elementary sub-figure of Y defined by φ(X⁰). By construction 𝔏 = Dép(Y') for some Y' ◁ Y. So by definition X ≪̊ Y', 'OK'.

(Ax 2) a) is immediate from condition (ω). b) Given X ≪̊ Y and X' related to X by ⊴ (written vertically under X), find Y' ∈ Ỹ with X' ≪̊ Y'. He calls this immediate.

(Ax 3) X |∘| Y translates on the Dép side: if S and T are the largest elements of Dép X and Dép Y, then X|∘|Y iff S|∘|T in Σ. Ax 3 then follows from downward heredity of |∘| in Σ: S|∘|T, S' ≤ S, T' ≤ T ⇒ S'|∘|T'.

(Ax 4) This axiom does not involve ≪̊. It is not a consequence of anything and must be imposed in advance.

The next page draws the conclusion. An atelier spatial is described by (𝒜, ⊴, |o|) alone, with three axioms: ⊴ is an order and |o| is symmetric (and reflexive); X ⊴ Y ⇒ X|o|Y; and X ↦ Dép X is injective. The polar Y^o = {Z | ∀Z', Z'|o|Y ⇒ Z'|o|Z} enters there. He then restarts with Σ as the base set.
errors: Ax 2 b) is declared 'immédiat' without argument. The direction of the ⊴ relation between X and X' is written vertically and is ambiguous, and Ỹ is not defined on this page.
The step '𝔏 will be of the form Dép(Y')' is asserted from an earlier construction (φ(X⁰)) not shown here. Its validity depends on hypotheses established on earlier pages.

ideas.what: Transporting the atelier relations (≪̊, |∘|) to an ambient ordered set with complement via X ↦ Dép(X), and checking the axioms there
ideas.modern_name: Representation of an abstract incidence/mereological structure in a set-based model; close to orthogonality spaces and closure via polars
ideas.usually_credited_to: Orthogonality spaces: Dacey 1968, Foulis–Randall; polarities: Birkhoff; formal concept analysis: Wille 1982
ideas.where_published: unsure; the 'ateliers' material appears to exist only in these 1986 manuscripts

ideas.what: Deriving the axiom for |∘| from downward heredity of a separation/compatibility relation in Σ
ideas.modern_name: Monotone (hereditary) binary relation, e.g. disjointness or compatibility

missed.claim: This page's transport of |∘| to the ambient Σ feeds into the next page's reduction of the atelier to (𝒜, ⊴, |o|). There, a reflexive symmetric relation and its polar Y^o recover the structure. This is formally the setting of orthogonality spaces and of Galois-closure reconstructions, which the notes do not cite. The link is suggestive but not developed on this page.
missed.quote: Et l'axiome Ax 3 résulte de la relation induite dans Σ  S|∘|T, S' ≤ S, T' ≤ T ⟹ S'|∘|T'
missed.why_it_might_matter_today: It would situate Grothendieck's little-known 'ateliers' within the theory of orthogonality spaces, polarities and point-free geometry. That framing would aid any edition of these notes.

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a routine axiom-by-axiom verification inside an unpublished, obscure axiomatization. The only interest is that the whole 'ateliers spatiaux' programme is undocumented in the literature; this page adds no new result.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: the crossed-out symbol after 𝔏 appears to be '≤ K-Dép', a false start, before '≤ Dép(Y)'.
Ax 2 b): 'X ▽ X'' is written vertically, with X' under X joined by a rotated ⊴ symbol, so it means X' ⊴ X or X ⊴ X'. It is not a separate relation ▽.
Ax 3: the line '−T ——— Dép Y' is a ditto construction, i.e. 'T le plus grand élément de Dép Y'.
Ax 3 implication: the handwriting reads 'S' ≤ S, T' ≤ T' (order of Σ) rather than ⊆.
Ax 2 a): 'immédiat par (ω)', with a parenthesized label (ω).
